main_text.head: CULTUM DIVINUM EXHIBENT CREATURÆ, IN SANCTORUM, RELIQUIARUM, IMAGINUM, REBUM CONSECRATARUM, ET SACRAMENTI EUCHARISTIÆ VENERATIONE. PAPISTÆ IGITUR IN SANCTORUM, RELIQUIARUM, IMAGINUM, REBUM CONSECRATARUM, ET SACRAMENTI EUCHARISTIÆ VENERATIONE COMMITTUNT IDOLOLATRIAM.
main_text.p: Hujus syllogismi pro-positio evidens est è Scripturis. In quibus {a}idolola-triæ vocantur, 1. Cor.10.7. Eph.5.5. qui divinum cultū idolo, sive proprie dicto, ut {b}simulacro viruli; Exod.32.4. Act.7.41. sive figurate, ut {c}mam-monæ, Matt.6.24. Ier.17.7. tribuunt. Assumtio, partim è Scripturis: partim ex aliis testibus idoneis. Nam Scripturæ docent {d}fiduciam, Psal.50.15. {e}invocationem, Ioel.2.32. Rom.10.14. {f}vota, Esai.19.21. {g}sacrifi-cia, Exod.22.20. & {h}adorationem divinum esse cultum. Exod.20.5. Act.10.26. Horum autem quædam se deferre Sanctis, quædam reliquiis, quædam imaginibus, nonnulla rebus consecratis & sacramento Eucharistiæ, testantur {i}Pontificii ipsi. Apoc.19.10. Missa l. Pontifical. Breviar. & lib. ceremoniar. Conclusionem ex præmissis necessario cōsequi, non est opus ut adjiciam. Optandum potius ut Ecclesiæ Romanæ filii concludant id ad se spectare, quod filiis Israelitica à Deo dictum legimus: Romanæ Ecclesiæ: Scholast. theolog. Canó. Histor. & Concil. Trident. {k}Contendite cum matre vestra, contendite, ipsam non esse uxorem meam, & me non esse virum ipsius: ut amoveat fornicationes suas e conspectu suo, & adulteria sua e medio uberum suorum: ne denudem eam plane, & statuam eam ut die quo genita fuit; disponensque eam velut in deserto, & redigens eam velut in terra siticulosa, exstinguam eam siti; & filiorum eius non miserear, eo quod filii scor-ti sint.
2 Atque hoc quidem facturos est sperandum,

page.notes: Running head and page number are as printed. The heading is set in capitals and is treated as a level 2 title above the passage. Marginal note marks: the asterisk-like sign before "1. Cor." is read as "a" [?]. The mark before "Hos." is read as "k", and the reference itself reads "HoL2.2." [?], so it is given as "Hos.2.2." [?]; the note is not placed with a letter. The "k" note was placed beside the text mark "k" in the text. The note "Romanæ Ecclesiæ: ..." has no printed mark and is placed beside the lines it stands by. "Canó." is printed "Canó." [?]. Printing errors left as printed: "viruli" for "vituli"; "REBUM" in the heading is printed "REBVM"; "Israelitica" [?]; "filii scor-ti sint" with the printed hyphen at the line end. "cōsequi" is printed with a long s and an abbreviation mark over the o [?]. The lowest line of text "quot-" is the catchword.
